title: Weight Zones & Equipment Sizing

changelog.change: Initial entry — readable presentation of the 9-zone equipment table, the age→weight fallback formulae, and the ETT-size / vitals rules of thumb.

purpose: A visual/navigation anchor that maps a child's weight to equipment sizes. The colour zone NEVER supplies a drug dose — every dose and fluid volume is computed live from the exact weight (or an age estimate). The zone gives equipment sizes and a shared colour only.
ageRange: Neonate to ~50 kg (roughly term birth to 12–14 years)

body.text: Weigh the child if at all possible. Use an age estimate only when a weight is genuinely unmeasurable, and flag the result as 'estimated'. Zone boundaries are design parameters, not clinical constants — confirm the defibrillator pad crossover against the specific device in use.

items: Uncuffed ETT size = (age/4) + 4; cuffed = (age/4) + 3.5. Depth (cm at lip) ≈ ETT size × 3, or (age/2) + 12.
Cuffed tubes are now preferred beyond the neonatal period (keep cuff pressure < 20–25 cmH2O).
Lowest acceptable SBP ≈ 70 + (2 × age in years) for ages 1–10; < 70 in neonates/infants is hypotension.
Defibrillation 2 J/kg first shock, 4 J/kg subsequent (up to the adult dose). Synchronised cardioversion 0.5–1 J/kg, then 2 J/kg.
Fluid bolus 10–20 mL/kg isotonic crystalloid, reassess after each; 10 mL/kg in DKA, cardiogenic, or neonates.

buildNote: Presentation layer over content/config/weight-zones.json. Doses always come from the live weight, never from the zone.
